fields.options: Each department is audited against its own checklist, in the order of the rows below. A department with no rows uses the general checklist. QC Managers can also change a department's checklist from the Round Audits tab of the tracker (Edit checklist). Saved audits keep the items they were scored on, so changing a checklist does not change old audits.
